description: Fix broken ModelSelect popover (Headless UI v2 Transition issue) and improve AI Settings page layout with provider grouping

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover by removing Transition wrapper
tasks.description: Remove the `<Transition as={Fragment}>` wrapper around `Popover.Panel` in ModelSelect component (AiSettingsSection.tsx lines 257–265 and closing tag line 322). Keep `Popover.Panel` as a direct child. Also remove the unused `Fragment` import and the `Transition` import from `@headlessui/react` if no longer needed elsewhere in the file.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelSelect component renders Popover.Panel directly without Transition wrapper
Popover.Panel opens when clicking the trigger button (Panel renders to DOM)
Popover.Panel closes when clicking outside or selecting a model
Search input inside Popover auto-focuses on open
All ModelSelect instances work: Mohist Model, Coder Model, Stage Model Overrides
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: This is the critical bug fix. The Transition wrapper prevents Popover.Panel from ever rendering in Headless UI v2.

tasks.title: Reorder AI Settings sections and add collapsible provider grouping
tasks.description: Reorder the JSX sections in AiSettingsSection's return: Model Selection first, then Providers, Custom Providers, Stage Overrides. Split the Providers section into two visual groups: connected providers (always visible) and unconfigured providers (collapsible, default-collapsed). Add `availableExpanded` state. When provider search is active, force-expand the unconfigured group. Show provider count in the collapsed header.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection section appears before Providers section on the page
Connected providers render in their own always-visible group
Unconfigured providers render in a collapsible group defaulting to collapsed
Collapsed group header shows provider count (e.g. 'Available Providers (75)')
Clicking the collapsed header toggles the unconfigured provider list
Provider search filters across both groups and force-expands the unconfigured group when search is active
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: Reuses ChevronRightIcon + rotate-90 pattern from Stage Model Overrides for the collapsible header.
